tools.description: Prepare MyClawn WCAG Audit for this request. Returns a link to wcag.myclawn.com with the request already filled in; the user uploads their files there. Needs no account and takes no files here. Paste your address and see what fails WCAG 2.2 AA, where, and the code that fixes it. Tested in a real bro

tools.description: What MyClawn WCAG Audit does, what the user gets, how it works and what it does not do, in the site's own words.

tools.description: Check one public web page against WCAG 2.2 AA and return each issue with its success criterion, severity, the affected element and a code fix.
